Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Glamour Cuts Barber Shop is a full-service beauty salon offering a range of hair and beauty services, including haircuts, coloring, styling, and grooming for both men and women. Our experienced team of licensed cosmetologists and barbers prioritizes health and safety by adhering to strict sanitation protocols and utilizing high-quality products. We ensure a comfortable and welcoming environment for all clients, with ongoing training for staff on best practices for hygiene and customer service. In addition to core services, we also offer specialty treatments such as scalp massages and facials, providing a holistic approach to beauty and self-care.
